```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Department of Energy has utterly failed in its mission to safeguard America's energy security.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission has been no better.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) has been shutting off America's energy pipeline with a regulatory blitz that has only just begun.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"36 oil refineries have closed in the last eight years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Not a single new refinery has been built in this country in the last quarter-century.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"EPA's patchwork of regulations has driven fuel prices higher in some areas than in others.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"EPA's patchwork of regulations has made energy supplies no longer fungible.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"What meets EPA's standards in one city may not be legally sold in another.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The result has been localized shortages and sharp price spikes, as suppliers scramble to get acceptable fuels to the markets where they are needed.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
